The diameter \(AB\) forms a straight angle, so the angles in the upper half of the disk sum to \(180^\circ\).

The shaded sector’s central angle is therefore
\[
180^\circ-(40^\circ+50^\circ+30^\circ)=60^\circ.
\]
Since the point is chosen uniformly from the whole disk, the probability is the fraction of the disk occupied by the sector:
\[
\frac{60^\circ}{360^\circ}=\frac16.
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{1}{6}}
\]
